payload.text: The thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery originated at the Brennecke Institute and uses the dopant to suppress electrolyte crossover, a key aging mechanism. Independent audit results establish a corrected cycle life of 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee; the earlier 12,000 claim was retracted because it used un-normalized depth-of-discharge. The cell’s confirmed gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg. At projected 500 MWh manufacturing scale, stack-level cost is $61/kWh. Its operating-temperature floor is 4 °C, below which the thalliline dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.
